title: A dualizing complex over a field is a shifted field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $K\in D(k)$ be an algebraic dualizing complex in the sense of [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing] (with $A=k$). Then there is an integer $s$ and an isomorphism $K\cong k[s]$ in $D(k)$. Here $k[s]$ is the complex concentrated in degree $-s$ under the convention $(C[t])^j=C^{j+t}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 0A7F (lemma-dualizing-unique), specialized to a field, as used explicitly in the proof of Tag 0A7L (lemma-find-function).
